From building jet engines as a teenager to his work as a physicist at Los Alamos National Labs, Bob Lazar's life has always been rooted in the pursuit of science. In 1988, he was hired to work at a classified facility known as S4, a site hidden within the perimeter of Area 51. There, he and 22 other scientists were tasked with reverse-engineering extraterrestrial technology.

Narrated by Lazar himself, the film brings his story to life through highly realistic recreations of exactly what he witnessed inside the S4 facility — supported by never-before-seen evidence, exclusive interviews with George Knapp, Gene Huff, Mario Santa Cruz, and Joy Lazar, and unprecedented access to one of America's most well-kept secrets.
